concerns.text: FR-008 requires that all reported associations be explicitly framed as correlational. No task (e.g., T006, T011) mentions adding this framing to output artifacts or interpretation files, so the requirement is uncovered.

FR-009 mandates exclusion of datasets with unvalidated agency instruments. While T002 records `instrument_valid` in `download_status.json`, downstream tasks (T004, T005, T006) never check this flag before proceeding, risking analysis on invalid data.
